source.feature: single 1-minute scalar motion index MI; raw X/Y/Z accelerometer axes are not in this source table
source.target: human-reviewed GR, RE, RU, WA behavior labels
source.classLabelProtocol: One-minute labels; class assigned at >=30 seconds, otherwise previous label carried forward.

oofCoverage.note: This file is the frozen grouped-by-animal OOF output; this diagnostic does not retrain, tune, or change its predictions.

duplicateTimestampAudit.handlingInFrozenOof: Same-label repeats collapsed to one animal-minute by mean MI; all rows at conflicting-label keys excluded.

temporalDependence.interpretation: Pairs are only exact one-minute timestamp neighbors; gaps break temporal continuity. The source label protocol carries the prior label forward when a behavior lasts under 30 seconds, so label persistence is partly protocol-induced.

ranchProvenance.mappingBasis: Primary Figshare record's dataset description maps AH and RC herds to Jornada Experimental Range (USDA), and BR and BH herds to Chihuahuan Desert Rangeland Research Center (NMSU). The CSV contains Breed, ID, timestamp, MI, State, Behavior, but no ranch field.
ranchProvenance.leaveOneRanchOutLimitation: Only two sites; breed is fully nested within site (AH/RC only at Jornada, BR/BH only at CDRRC), so site shift is confounded with breed and two outer folds cannot establish general cross-ranch transportability.

failureDiagnosis: Resting (RE) is the main weak class: it is most often predicted as rumination (RU), a biologically plausible but task-relevant error because the target labels distinguish those behaviors.

A single scalar MI discards direction/axis and fine-grained head/jaw motion; source documentation describes RU and RE as both static and the article summary reports no detected MI difference between them.
Temporal records are not independent: labels and errors persist across adjacent minutes, while the source annotation protocol explicitly carries previous labels forward for sub-30-second behaviors.
The current grouped split prevents animal-ID leakage, but has the same ranch/date/sensor context in train and test; it cannot demonstrate new-ranch transfer.

freezeBeforeRun: Freeze the source file checksum, class definitions, the already used duplicate policy, class order, two site assignments from primary source provenance, and the exact outer/inner fold memberships before any new fit.
Keep the four original labels as the primary endpoint. Do not merge RE/RU after inspecting outer results; a 3-class or 2-state endpoint must be predeclared as a separate analysis.
Use only causal sensor features. No future MI and no ground-truth behavior lags are allowed; reset temporal windows at time gaps.
preregisteredNextEvaluation.outerCV: Six fixed grouped folds over 24 animals, one animal per breed per fold (the current balanced animal split), with all observations from each animal held together.
preregisteredNextEvaluation.innerCV: Within each 20-animal outer-training partition, five grouped folds, each holding one animal per breed. Fit scaling, thresholds, class weights, and all hyperparameters using inner-training animals only.

candidateFamilies.limit: One pre-specified hierarchical set of MI cutpoints for the four classes; all cutpoints selected only in inner folds.
MI only; fixed small L2 grid [0.1, 1, 10] expressed as inverse regularization C; preprocessing and equal-animal/class weights fitted on inner training only.
MI only; depth [2, 3, 4] and minimum leaf [30, 60] candidate grid; no post-hoc pruning based on outer metrics.
Current MI, prior 1/2/4-minute MI lags and causal 3/5-minute trailing mean; no future values or label-history features; evaluate all candidate families on identical rows with complete causal history.

selectionCriterion.primary: Maximize equal-animal-weighted mean of per-class F1 for RE and RU on inner grouped OOF predictions.
tieBreakers: Higher minimum of RE and RU recall.
Lower model complexity (threshold/rule, then logistic, then shallower tree, then temporal model).
selectionCriterion.outerReporting: After one model family/hyperparameter setting is selected inside each outer training partition, report outer OOF confusion, per-class precision/recall/F1, equal-animal-weighted metrics, per-animal metrics, and fold-specific results. No candidate is selected using outer outcomes.
selectionCriterion.sameCases: For temporal comparisons, compare every candidate on the same rows with complete prior-window history; separately state the omitted startup/gap rows.

preregisteredNextEvaluation.crossRanchStressTest: Because primary Figshare provenance maps AH/RC to Jornada and BR/BH to CDRRC, a supplementary two-fold leave-one-ranch-out evaluation is possible by grouping the 12 cows at each site. Keep this separate from the 6-fold nested animal CV; breed and site are perfectly confounded, only two sites exist, and the result cannot estimate broad ranch-to-ranch transportability.
preregisteredNextEvaluation.reportingGuardrail: If RE/RU weak-class F1 remains low, report four-class behavior classification as not ready; do not use overall accuracy or merge labels post hoc to claim success.

scopeGuardrails: No candidates were fitted or tuned in this diagnostic step.
The existing Perea OOF behavior scores are not evidence for DMI, ADG, forage intake, BR-CORTE, or the Riose engine.
CPER and Grazing Ingestive Behavior remain separate cohorts with different grains and targets.
